system.description: You know how to set charges to direct a blast in a specific direction or manner. You can shape an explosion caused by Explosives or Mines that you set into a line or a cone instead of a radius. The length of the line is equal to 2 x the radius of the explosive Burst; the length of the cone is equal to 3 x the radius of the Burst, and either the line or the cone originates from the square where the Explosives are placed.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
